implementation.profile: Production drivers enumerate realtime-single-step 1.0. A device with PM_EXT_simulation_profile accepts only the immutable profile name/version/chain and the fixed 1/60 second, one-substep step contract; rejected requests never fall back to legacy execution.
implementation.eligibility: Current executable production scope is rigid/query simulations. Fluid, cloth, rope, soft-body, smoke, coupling, emitter, destroyer, paint and debug capacities return PM_ERROR_FEATURE_NOT_PRESENT before allocation. Interaction capability advertisement is unchanged.
implementation.public_observation: PM_QUERY_REALTIME_STEP_STATISTICS exposes the legacy step result plus versioned per-tick totals, seven ordered phase records, time advances, six domain iteration totals and coupling work. The query encloses exactly one realtime profile step.
implementation.installed_consumer: An out-of-tree C consumer loads the relocated SDK and production Slang CPU manifest, builds geometry and one dynamic rigid body, submits one profiled tick, waits on its fence, reads simulation status and realtime statistics, copies public rigid state, and emits JSON with validation disabled and enabled.
implementation.oracle: realtime_oracle.py requires the exact installed-public-api source marker, profile, candidate-manifest input, public operation sequence, successful status, step/version counters, finite copied state and complete per-tick work counters. Mock execution and driver-private state are rejected.
implementation.candidate_boundary: realtime-single-step-v1-dea47c1 remains rejected history and is named only as a qualification-input manifest. Observations set execution_identity_claimed=false. F8-36 owns the single replacement executable candidate identity.
